title: Visible lanes cap at 3 - additional overlapping shifts collapse into a '+N more' affordance that opens a popover
custom_preconds:
1. You are signed in on a desktop browser.
2. One technician has FIVE mutually overlapping shifts at the same time on the same day (seed ZZAUTOTEST work orders as needed).
3. You are on the Schedule page in day view.
custom_steps:
1. Count the visible lanes in the technician's row.
2. Find and click the '+N more' affordance.
custom_expected:
1. At most 3 lanes are visible.
2. The remaining overlapping shifts collapse into a '+N more' affordance (here '+2 more').
3. Clicking it opens a popover listing the hidden shifts.
4. The hidden shifts can be opened from that popover.
